title: Magnetically recoverable cobalt oxide nanoparticle catalyst for PET glycolysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,42956-42967
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05618G, Paper

Deepthi Thomas, Parvathy C., Benny K. George
A magnetically recoverable Co–B/CONP core–shell catalyst with 97% BHET yield, reported for the first time. The unique core–shell structure contributes to the inherent ferromagnetism, while its high surface area enhances catalytic performance.
